name: El Lissitzky
summary: Prouns (axonometric constructions floating on a textured ground), the 1923 Victory over the Sun figurines, and red-black-white agitprop. No legible words in any alphabet.

proun.about: a Proun: beams, slabs and discs in axonometric projection floating on a pale textured ground

figurine.about: a 1923-lithograph mechanical stage figure built from red, black and graphite-grey geometric parts on a white sheet

poster.about: a flat red-black-white agitprop poster: one hard division, a driving wedge or circle, scattered bars

public_summary: Works dated 1930 or earlier only (US public domain): Prouns, the 1923 Victory over the Sun figurines, posters, book and magazine design, typography, photomontage.
